subject: planner: add ds allAccessPaths to keep the original derived paths from tableInfo. (#59928)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its first parent. The change introduces DataSource.AllPossibleAccessPaths as the stable “full” access-path set derived during build, and switches stats derivation / property preparation and several logical rules to consult that full set instead of the heuristically pruned PossibleAccessPaths (which remains the input to physical enumeration). buildDataSource and PartitionProcessor.resolveAccessPaths both populate/refresh AllPossibleAccessPaths. No Blocker/High issues found in correctness or SQL semantics from the diff and required surrounding callers.
